correctness.rationale: The exact three-moment operator follows by conditioning on the two Bernoulli branches. Its complete cubic Jury test reduces stability to \(ps[2p-(2-p)s]>0\), because the remaining Jury expressions have explicit positive minima or monotone positive forms. A separate geometric-renewal calculation gives the same necessity boundary for the standard zero-residual initialization and yields the exact cycle optimum.

Those results do not specialize to the independent Bernoulli compressor's exact second-moment operator. The closest published records concern different stochastic feedback or deterministic operator recurrences.

value.rationale: Random sparsification is a canonical communication compressor for which memory/error feedback was introduced. The finding identifies the exact geometric-delay overshoot mechanism and its sharp constant-step stability cost, \(2p/(2-p)\), while the communication-cycle optimum quantifies the compression-rate tradeoff. The comparison with memoryless dropout isolates residual accumulation as the source of the stability loss on the smallest natural benchmark.
